author: Justin Van Dyck
text: Did not show for scheduled septic pump. Called and they said work was completed. I reverified they did not complete the work. Second call representative said they completed work and would have a supervisor help me. Supervisor essentially called me a liar and said he would send someone investigate. A representative called me to schedule inspection. After 4 calls and well over an hour on the phone they provided the service they had already charged for and not completed. Terrible service!

author: Shara Olivieri
text: Used this company for a pump and certification for a home under contract. Was told that they would have to come out on one day to uncover the lids and then the next day they would come out and do the pumping and certification. They said they could not give me a total cost until after the digging was done on the first day. They called me back after that first day and told me what time they would show up the following day for the pump and gave me a total which I relayed to my client. Property is vacant so my client had to drive an hour to meet them physically to pay them and they were 40 minutes late after they asked if they could come early. My client was invoiced and paid the bill which was for the same amount I was quoted over the phone the day before. Then Friday afternoon we received an email stating that the bill had not been paid in full, and that the certification would not be released until we paid in full. According to them they had “missed “an extra hour of digging. They blamed it on the fact that the person who normally does the paperwork was out of the office until the day we received that email that the invoice was not paid in full, even though their office had given us an invoice for the amount that was quoted over the phone. Their departments do not communicate well with each other, and their customer service is lacking. Would not use them again for another transaction.

author: Cindy Walker
text: Very good service, the worker they sent was more than helpful, the weather elements that morning we're less than optimum but he powered right through it. Would definitely call again for their services.

author: Alicia Santos
text: Silvo is the man. After a bit of confusion with customer service, I ended up satisfied with the service.  PUMPING SEPTIC. I have to say that Silvo the on-site technician made the difference.  He was knowledgeable, professional and friendly.

author: Cathleen Armstrong
text: The entire staff has been professional and helpful. The men who did the work at our home explained everything in a way I clearly understood.
